question.text: Higher volatility affects option premiums by:

answer.text: Increasing premiums for BOTH call and put options
Increasing call premiums but decreasing put premiums

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook, volatility affects calls and puts the same way — higher volatility raises premiums for both because the option is more likely to move ITM. The Trap: Unlike the underlying price, strike, or interest rates, which move calls and puts in opposite directions, volatility moves both premiums in the same direction. Note: This is the only one of the standard pricing factors that does not have an opposite sign for calls versus puts.
